settings.move.title: Move a member's documents
settings.move.lead: Everything one member sent, and their templates, then belong to another member. Each document's history says who moved it, and its certificate keeps who sent it first.
settings.move.what: {documents} and {templates} then belong to {to}. Each history says you moved them. There is no undo, but you can move them back the same way.
